comment: The mix is summed, high-pass filtered, clamped to 46V of headroom, divided by 35 and put through an antiderivative-antialiased polynomial tanh before being scaled by 6.9 and the master volume (PressedDuck.cpp:1002). The compression divides the summed peak by the number of strips that actually carry a signal (PressedDuck.cpp:860), so PRESS behaves differently as strips are patched and unpatched. Shift-clicking a mute button solos that strip (PressedDuck.cpp:665).
